rows.label: tlk70000056_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Some adults look scary, but the people
here have been really kind.

rows.label: tlk70000056_03_msg0002
rows.name:
Some people knew Dad and tell me it
must've been hard, or say they feel
sorry for me, but...

rows.label: tlk70000056_03_msg0003
rows.name:
I'm not someone to feel sorry for.
Dad and Kei are here with me.

rows.label: tlk70000056_03_msg0004
rows.name:
I think having a hard time and being
someone to pity are different things.
